module: Flowgraph node "Decal Circle" (category repeat_instant, util/draw). Draws a circle of decals on the ground, like a radial loading bar. Input pins: pos (center), radius, decalScale ({1,1,3}), amount (32 decals), inverted, decalPath, filling1 (0 to 100, progress), filling2 (0 to 100, refill), colors filledColor, fillingColor1, fillingColor2, backgroundColor. Sends the decals to Engine.Render.DynamicDecalMgr.addDecals every frame.
notes: data.snapToTerrain = true is defined but unused in this file.
The decals have fadeStart 200 and fadeEnd 250.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the decal pool and the color caches.

work.desc: Updates the color caches, computes the position, direction, color and scale of each decal on the circle and submits them to the renderer.
